notes: Eclipse Loop 2.5.0 Song sections you can move as one, ghost clips, track folders, draggable warp markers, and the mixer details a real session asks for. This is the release where the arranger stops being a timeline you place things on and starts being one you can restructure. The arrangement track Click SECTIONS for a lane under the ruler holding named blocks — Intro, Verse, Chorus. Set the loop over some bars, right-click the lane and Add section over the loop region, then rename it. Duplicate section inserts a copy after it and pushes the rest of the song along: "another chorus" in one click. Delete section removes its bars too and closes the gap. Left-click a section to loop it. Everything reflows together — clips, tempo, meter and markers. The distinction worth holding on to: a marker is a point you jump to, a section is a range you move as one. Ghost clips Right-click a clip and Duplicate as ghost. The copy shares the original's content: edit the notes in either one and both change. Ghosts are labelled GHOST on the clip so you always know which is which. Content follows; placement does not
